title: Christmas Santa Cupcakes
description: Turn plain cupcakes into these cute Santa faces with these easy decorating suggestions.
ingredients: 12 red candy-coated chocolate pieces (such as M&M's®)

steps.text: Frost each cupcake with a thin layer of vanilla frosting. Pour red sprinkles into a small bowl and dip the lower third of each frosted cupcake into the sugar to make Santa's hat. Create a white rim for the hat by placing about 6 white chocolate chips, flat-side up, at the edge of the red sugar section. Stick 1 white chocolate chip on the top as a pom-pom.
Place 2 mini chocolate chips in Santa's face for the eyes and a red candy-coated chocolate piece for the nose. Sprinkle coconut flakes over the bottom third for the beard.

video.description: Ho, ho, ho! Get in the Christmas spirit with these jolly Santa cupcakes. All you need is your favorite vanilla cupcake recipe, or even start with store-bought and get right to the decorating! Red sugar, white chocolate chips, coconut, and frosting is all you need to decorate these cupcakes for loads of fun for the whole family.
